data.title: Deferred - screen component split, and Signals Reassigned feedback loop

meta.title: Deferred - screen component split
meta.description:
## Deliberate simplifications for this slice

1. **Assign Signal to Project (B1) has 2 visual components** (signal-context card, project radio list) fed by 2 different read models (SignalListView, ProjectListView). Per eventmodeling-identifying-outputs Step 5c, strict practice is to split this into 2 marked/highlighted screen copies, one per component. Kept as a single screen here since both fields groups are small and static-in-this-slice - flagging as accepted debt rather than fragmenting the model this early.

(Removed: the old 'Signals Reassigned' retroactive-reassignment flow was deliberately deleted from the model - event sourcing means past signals keep whatever assignment they had at the time; assigning a project only ever creates/updates the matching sender rule for *future* signals, it never reaches back to touch history.)
